answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Issuance tied to graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 9 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 700 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. History cannot be faked faster than the epochs themselves pass. A fable of doubt is healthy, a island of proof is required, and a meadow of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
